title: Volume 1 Chapter 16: Fanatic
series: Reincarnated as a Mob in a Magical Girl Anime
content: Chapter 16: Fanatic
"Man... yesterday was truly a wonderful day..."
While recalling the Selec attack event from last night, I relaxed on the school roof.
To think I'd get to see such an absolute masterpiece of Luna's *kumorase*...! I'm truly glad to be alive... I've never seen *kumorase* that amazing before...
As expected, *kumorase* = justice. That expression of despair was truly irresistible.

Still, to think that saving Luna—who was supposed to die—would change the anime's development this much... It's a bit of a shame that I won't get to see the *kumorase* from the anime... but fufufu, that just means I'll get to see *kumorase* that I don't even know about yet!!
Thinking about what kind of *kumorase* awaits me from now on, a smile naturally spills from my lips.
Alrighttt!! Just you wait, *kumorase*!!
While my inner excitement was skyrocketing and my heart was dancing at the thought of unknown *kumorase*, the roof door opened.
Oh, speak of the devil.
"Yo, Reina, good work."
"Good work to you too, Sōta."
Luna appeared, sat down next to me, took out two bentos as usual, and plopped one onto my lap.
"Here, the usual."
"Thanks, I was starving, so this is a huge help."
I woke up at the very last minute today and missed breakfast, after all...
I immediately opened the wrapping and dug into the bento.
So goood... As expected, Luna's bento is delicious... as expected of a magical girl.
"How does it taste?"
"Delicious, as usual."
"I see, that's good."
Saying that somewhat brusquely but seemingly happy, Luna also began to eat her bento.
After that, there was no particular conversation.
Back during Luna's *kumorase* period, it was awkwardly quiet to the point of death, but by now this had become normal.
...For it to become normal for a mere General Mob A to eat lunch with a magical girl is quite a problem, isn't it... Well, whatever. The food is good.
"Hey, Sōta."
"Hm?"
When I asked back, Luna tucked her hair behind her ear and muttered, looking just a little embarrassed.
"Um... thank you. Thanks to you, I was able to make up with my friends."
"Heh, well that's good."
Of course, I already knew that.
I love magical girl *kumorase*, but before that, I love magical girls themselves. And as a magical girl fan, while I want them to experience *kumorase*, I also want them to get along.
That's right, cooperating with comrades to stand against a great enemy... because that's what makes a magical girl!
"...For me to be the one thanking you, that's quite a lackluster reaction."
"I mean, I didn't really do anything, so it feels weird being thanked."
"Anyway, I'm grateful to you. So let me thank you properly."
Did I do something...?
I was just acting to ensure I could see the best *kumorase* this time around too...
"Thank me how?"
"I'll be waiting in front of the main gate after school today. Come."
"I'll come if I can."
"You absolutely will come."
Seeing right through my attempt to bail, she nailed me down.
"I might have some errands come up."
"You just had one come up. With me."
"...Actually, I'm hanging out with a friend today."
"When I asked your friend, he said he had no time to waste on a guy like you, you know?"
That bastard... I'll punch him in the face next time I see him.
As expected, friendship between mobs is a fleeting, fragile thing. I misjudged you, Seito-kun.

No, more importantly than that trivial stuff... this is bad... she's completely cut off my escape routes... this is the kind of thing where I have no choice but to go... I'd really like to refrain from taking any more actions that exceed the boundaries of a mob!!!??
"Do I have the right to refuse?"
"You don't."
"So basically it's mandatory."
"It's mandatory."
She said something quite unreasonable in a clear, beautiful voice.
"Alright, alright, I get it."
"Fufu, as long as you understand. I'm sure you'll enjoy it. Both you... and me."
Luna muttered that meaningfully with a fearless smile.
I'll enjoy it too...? Don't tell me... is it *kumorase*!!
"Hmm... well then, I'll look forward to it."
"Yes, look forward to it."
Saying that, Luna smiled softly.
*Kumorase* ♪ *Kumorase* ♪ Fuffu, I can't wait...!
...There was a time when I thought that too.
As promised with Luna, when I went to the front gate, what was waiting for me was Luna and a super luxury car like you'd only see in anime or manga.
Then I was forcefully put into the car by Luna and brought to this super VIP pool in a luxury hotel. Completely reserved just for us, no less.
And currently, having been made to change into a swimsuit, I was sitting on a poolside chair watching the sunset.
No, well... of course this is how it is... yeah, I definitely wasn't thinking that I might get to see just a little bit... just a tiny bit of *kumorase*... not at all...
"Well, since I'm here, I might as well enjoy it."
As expected of a luxury hotel, you can order various foods and drinks right from the poolside.
The tradeoff is that the prices are absurdly high, but since Luna is apparently paying for everything, it's not a problem at all.
"Man... this is the best...!"
Drinking juice and eating a lavish fruit platter on someone else's dime is the absolute best!
It's incredibly disappointing that it wasn't *kumorase*, but this is actually pretty great in its own right.
"—It seems you're enjoying yourself quite a bit."
While I was fully enjoying this VIP situation, a dignified, beautiful voice suddenly rang out.
Turning toward the voice, I unconsciously found myself captivated.
Naturally, the owner of the voice was Luna. But it wasn't just the usual Luna. Standing there was Luna in a swimsuit.

Wearing a pure white bikini, even though she had a pareo covering her lower half, she was naturally exposing more skin than usual, and her silver hair, like silver threads, stood out beautifully against her snow-white skin.
Crap... she's way too cute...!!
Wait, wait!! Luna's swimsuit is way too cute...!! This is bad, this is bad, what is this, the destructive power is off the charts!!
To think I would be able to see a magical girl's swimsuit with my own two eyes... This alone definitely made coming today worth it.
"Sorry to keep you waiting, Sōta."
Saying that, Luna directed a cute smile my way.
"Y-Yeah."
"So... what are your thoughts on seeing me in a swimsuit?"
As if to show off her proportions, Luna struck a bewitching pose.
She looks so divine I can almost see a halo of light behind her... She's basically a goddess.
"You're insanely cute! One of the five greatest beauties in the world!"
"I don't really understand this 'five greatest beauties in the world' thing... but I get that you're complimenting me, so thank you."

By the way, the five greatest beauties in the world obviously refers to my beloved magical girls. As the main characters of this world, it's a given that they're the cutest in the world. I will absolutely accept no objections.
I want to see the other magical girls in swimsuits someday too! If all five gathered, the world would be destroyed.
"...Were you just thinking about some other girl?"
"Could you not read my mind so casually? You're right, though."
"...Hmph, you've got some nerve. Fine, you are my pet—... no, never mind. Let's see, as punishment for thinking about other girls, I think I'll have you apply my sunscreen."
"Isn't there a lack of elements here to even get a sunburn?"
"I was lying."
Saying that jokingly, she sat in the chair next to mine.
If it's a joke, why does she actually have tanning oil...?
"This is a nice place, isn't it?"
"Yeah, it's a seriously nice place. I'd want to come every day."
I looked around the inside of the hotel a bit before coming here, but it's truly a completely different world from the one commoners live in. Everything is VIP specification.
"It's one of the top luxury hotels in the country. Normally, it's quite difficult to even get a reservation, you know?"
"Heh, so it's a really amazing hotel."
"...That's right."
I might never get to come to a luxury hotel pool like this again for the rest of my life, so I have no choice but to enjoy this rare opportunity to the fullest!
"Alright, since we're here, let's swim!"
"You're... going to swim?"
Luna's eyes widened in surprise.
I just realized... could this possibly be the type of pool where you just look at it instead of swimming in it!?
I don't understand the things rich people do, but maybe that's how it is.
"Isn't it a waste to come to a pool and not swim?"
"I suppose... it can't be helped... let's swim, then."
"Man, that was super delicious!"
After getting out of the pool, the dinner we ate at the luxury restaurant inside the hotel was full of flavors I had never tasted before, and it was simply the best.
『That roast beef in particular was excellent, Sōta!』
(Right, right, that was seriously delicious! The small portion size was a drawback, but...)
『Mhm! I have taken a liking to the food here, Sōta!』
(Glad you liked it.)
『Mhm! I would want to eat it every single day!』
(That's impossible since we'd go bankrupt after one meal.)
I wonder how much this all costs in total... At the very least, I know it would blow through my entire life savings in an instant.
"How was it? Are you satisfied?"
Luna asked for my thoughts in a seemingly excellent mood for some reason.
Sitting across from me, Luna was dressed appropriately for a luxury hotel restaurant. Completely different from the pure white swimsuit from earlier, she was now wearing a pitch-black dress.
The swimsuit from earlier was incredibly good too... but this is great too!
Seriously, Luna looks good in anything... As expected, magical girls are amazing... Just their existence alone is loved by the world...!
"Yeah, I'm super satisfied."
"I'm glad to hear that. That makes booking the highest grade course worth the trouble."
Heh... so this was the highest grade course... No wonder it was so good...
"Since we've finished eating, why don't we go to the bar over there for a bit? We have a beautiful night view, after all."
Looking closely, there was a bar attached to the restaurant. Ooh... it's my first time seeing a bar.
"I'm technically a minor, is that okay?"
"It's not like you're going to drink alcohol. They have non-alcoholic drinks too."
"I see."
And so, we sat at the bar counter seats.
A female bartender welcomed us with a smiling face.
"Have you decided on your order?"
"I'll have a Cinderella. And you?"
"Eh? Then... uh... grape juice."
"Understood."
After placing the order, the bartender put various syrups into a container and shook it *shaka shaka* with movements I had only ever seen in movies.
Amazing... as expected of a pro...
"...Hey, Sōta. Do you have something like a goal in life?"
While I was admiring the bartender's skills, Luna suddenly asked something like that.
"What's with the sudden question?"
"Isn't a bar a place for deep conversations? The atmosphere just made me feel like asking."
"I feel like I kinda understand that."
Now that she mentions it, in movies, bars are where shady-looking middle-aged men discuss backroom deals and stuff.
But this topic feels more like life counseling. I guess that's also a common trope in bars.
"So, do you have one?"
"I do. I have a critically important purpose in this mob life. It wouldn't be an exaggeration to say I came to this world solely for that purpose."
That's right, for me, *kumorase* is the very meaning of living. Admiring *kumorase* is my life. This alone will absolutely never change.
I would throw away everything for the sake of *kumorase*.
"In other words, what is that purpose?"
"Hmm, I can't tell you, Reina."
"...Why not?"
"I feel like goals are more likely to come true if you don't tell anyone."
"What's that about?"
Luna shot me a suspicious glare.
Naturally, I can't tell a magical girl to her face that I love seeing magical girls fall into despair...
"What about you, Reina?"
When I asked back, Luna's expression darkened slightly.
Oh, is it *kumorase* time...?
"I am... a little lost."
"About what?"
While suppressing my anticipation for *kumorase* as much as possible, I asked seriously.

"Until recently, I was convinced that doing what must be done for the sake of this world was the meaning of my life. But... after meeting that person... after being saved by him... I've started wanting to live for his sake... for his sake alone..."
"Is there something wrong with that?"
"Because... isn't it weird to live for one person instead of the world?"
"Isn't that pretty normal? Having someone more important than the world."
If I were asked to choose between magical girls and the world, I'd choose magical girls without hesitation, because that's how much I love them.
"Is it really okay... for me to live for his sake...?"
"It's fine. No one has the right to condemn that choice."
I was reincarnated into this magical girl anime world as a mob, and I'm doing whatever I please, thoroughly enjoying this mob life.
No matter what anyone says about this way of life, I have absolutely no intention of changing it. I will continue to simply admire the ultimate *kumorase* from now on as well.
"I see... I'm allowed to live for —'s sake...!"
Then, unfortunately, Luna floated a happy expression, as if her clouds had cleared.
Ah... the *kumorase* has slipped away...
"Thank you, Sōta. Thanks to you, I've decided on my life's path."
"That's... yeah, good to hear."
"Sorry to keep you waiting. Here is the Cinderella and the grape juice."
At that moment, two glasses were placed on the counter with a clink.
The Cinderella Luna had ordered, and the grape juice I had ordered.
『(Mhm, delicious!!)』
And as I muttered that in my heart, my voice overlapped with Voldia, the God of Ruin living inside me.
(Hey, don't overlap with my inner voice.)
『You and I are literally one body and soul! It's not rare for us to resonate!』
(Don't say gross things, it's going to ruin the taste of this premium grape juice.)
『Is that so? By enjoying the same flavor as you, it tastes even more delicious to me.』
(Okay, I fully understand that you're being creepy. Just be quiet for now.)
『Mhm!』
Even so, this is the first time I've ever had such delicious grape juice.
"Yeah, it's delicious. Not bad."
"Thank you very much."
The bartender bowed lightly, politely.
As expected of a pro.
"By the way, that suit looks good on you."
"Hm? Oh... thanks."
The suit I was currently wearing was one Luna gave me before entering the hotel. I always thought our school uniforms were made of nice fabric, but this is on another level.
Still, it fits my body strangely well...
"That's something I had custom-made for a certain person... but I never had the chance to give it to them. I'll give it to you."
"Seriously? Lucky me."
I got an expensive-looking suit for free!
Not that I have many occasions to wear it!
"Well then..."
I chugged the rest of my grape juice in one go and stood up.
"Thanks again. I really enjoyed myself today."
"It's fine. It's a thank you gift, after all."
"Right... well, see ya."
I turned my back to Luna and started walking.
"Where are you going?"
A voice called out to my back.
"I was thinking of going home."
"There is no need for that."
"Heh?"
Stopped from going home for some reason, I instinctively turned around.
Luna also finished her Cinderella, stood up, and walked over to me.
"Besides, today is far from over."
"What do you mean?"
"What do you think this is?"
Saying that, Luna produced a card from somewhere.
Hm? What's this...?
"This is the key to a room in this hotel."
"Oh, is that so. Can I go home now?"
"You are staying at this hotel tonight."
Luna muttered that with a mischievous tone.
"Huh?"
"Come on, let's go. If you don't hurry, I'll leave you behind."
"No way, I'm not staying."
Staying at a hotel with a magical girl is a little too... No, it's absolutely crossing a line that a mob should never cross!!!! I absolutely refuse!!!!
"You're staying."
"I'm not."
"You are staying."
"I'm not staying!"
A battle where neither side yielded an inch.
"...You're stubborn... Then here, take this."
Saying that, Luna held out a piece of paper.
"Hm? What's this..."
Taking the paper and reading its contents, I turned pale.
"Um... there's an incredibly large number written here... What is this number?"
"The pool usage fee, the meal fee, and the drink fee."
"Oh... seriously..."
It's way too expensive... What the hell is this amount...
"If you don't stay, you'll have to pay this in full... So I'll ask you again: are you staying?"
"...I'm staying."
"Fufu, that's a good boy."
And so, my stay was forcibly decided.
"...The bed is so soft... and the night view is beautiful..."
Shown to a room in the highest-class hotel, I took a bath in a jacuzzi and then flopped onto the bed.
As expected of a luxury hotel. The interior design is unnecessarily elaborate, decorated with things that all look expensive.
"This painting probably costs a lot too."
I wonder how much it would sell for...
I thought about such trivial things.
Now then... how did it come to this... Sleeping in the same room as a magical girl is an extremely grave situation for a mob!?
An event like this between a mere mob and a main character magical girl of this world should absolutely never happen. It must not happen!
...Is there still a chance for me to escape?
While I was seriously considering an escape route, the bathroom door opened.
"Phew, that was a good bath."
Luna's voice sounded more relaxed than usual.
Having just gotten out of the bath, Luna was wearing a bathrobe, and her snow-white skin was slightly flushed pink.
"...Good work."
I can't escape. Alright, I'll just give up and sleep.
"Yes... —Wait, are you already asleep?"
"Just resting a bit. But I'm sleepy, so I'm going to sleep now."
"Fine, but... listen to what I have to say first."
Saying that, Luna turned off all the lights in the room.
The room was barely visible through the moonlight and the lights of the buildings outside.
"Hey, Sōta."
"Hm?"
At that moment, Luna uttered a shocking statement.
"Do you know about magical girls?"
Faced with such a sudden question from the magical girl herself, my sleepiness vanished in an instant.
(Eh? What is this? What does this mean??? I completely don't understand the intent of the question!!! Help me, Professor Voldia!!!)
(Hey, don't ignore me.)
This God of Ruin just because it seemed troublesome... he ran away...!
...But the existence of magical girls is common knowledge in this world, so I should just answer normally.
"Yeah, of course. The girls of justice who protect us from demons every day, right?"
"That's right... Magical girls are girls who protect world peace... But you know, even those girls are just normal girls most of the time..."
"...I see... So what does that mean?"
"Fufu, well... It means—"
Luna floated a meaningful smile.
Hm? This room is... No, it's freezing!!
I suddenly realized that the room had gotten incredibly cold. Wait, there's white freezing air drifting around like inside a freezer—hm? Freezing air?
With a bad premonition, I directed my gaze toward Luna and saw the freezing air that had generated in the area gathering at her feet.
Hey, hey... don't tell me...!!
In that instant, the freezing air enveloped Luna's entire body.
Then, when the freezing air cleared, standing there was the transformed Magical Girl Luna.
"—It means this."
Luna spoke as if revealing a magic trick.
Uh... um, Luna-san? I'm supposed to be an ordinary mob high school student, so I'm not supposed to know a magical girl's true identity, you know???
For now, I'll just do an over-the-top reaction like a mob should.
"M-Magical Girl... Luna...!?"
"That's right... I, Reina Tachibana, am the true identity of Magical Girl Luna."
"N-No way... To think Reina was a magical girl..."
"Right? It's surprising, isn't it."
No, genuinely, the only emotion I have right now is surprise. Why did you go out of your way to show your magical girl form to a mob like me?
"By the way, Sōta... how did you know I was Luna?"
"It's obvious just by looking."
As a massive fan of magical girls, there's no way I wouldn't be able to tell them apart.
Whether they are in their civilian forms or transformed, I can absolutely identify them.
"I see... This black form of mine isn't very well known yet, but... Sōta, you can clearly tell that I am Luna, can't you?"
Luna smiled suspiciously, as if convinced of something.
Isn't this... bad? Actually, Luna is scary right now...
While I was completely unable to read her actions, Luna got onto the bed and approached me.
"Umm... aren't you a bit close?"
"Really? This is normal."
Saying that, Luna got even closer.
Looking at her again, she's an incredibly beautiful girl... eye candy...
"Now then... shall we begin..."
"Begin wha—it's cold!!??"
In that instant, my hands and feet were frozen and pinned to the bed.
This is bad... I can't move my limbs at all. What do I do...
"Caught you. Now you can't run away."
"Hey, hey, is an allied magical girl of justice allowed to do this to a frail, ordinary mob?"
"It's fine."
Luna brought her face close to mine.
"So... Sōta, I want you to tell me your true identity too. It's fine, right? After all, I'm your kin—"
Luna declared, as if already certain of the answer.
"Right? Omega ♡"
[img]https://i.imgur.com/wgtmQ3X.jpeg
"Right? Omega ♡"
I asked him the question I had been wanting to ask all along.
Then, perhaps completely unable to predict this situation, he seemed quite confused.

Back then, the mask broke, and I saw Omega's true face through the gap... rare black hair and crimson eyes. And the suit I had custom-made to match Omega's body measurements... he was wearing it flawlessly.
From these pieces of information, the possibility that Sōta was Omega grew higher and higher in my mind.
But... it wasn't certain yet... If I searched, there might be other men with black hair and red eyes, and the suit fitting could have just been a coincidence in size.
That's why I decided to make a gamble.
"O-Omega...? What the heck is that?"
"Don't mind it. I'm just going to check the answers myself."
I looked straight down at Sōta's face.
Then, I used my hand to cover all of Sōta's face except for his left eye.
"What are you doing all of a sudden."
Ah... I knew it... It perfectly matches the true face of Omega I saw back then without a single difference...!
In that instant, my love for him rushed through my entire body and dominated me, and a mighty power that I couldn't even control overflowed from me.
"H-Hey... Luna? What are you planning to do?"
"...Nnh ♡ Haa... it's fine... I'll end it... haa... quickly... ♡"
My breathing naturally grew heavy.
My body, my heart, was strongly craving him.
I won't... hold back anymore...!
Surrendering to my desires, I brought my face close to share a kiss with him.
However, at that moment, a black fog blocked my vision.
This is—.
When my vision cleared, the ice was completely destroyed, and Sōta's figure, which had been restrained on the bed, was completely gone.
At the same time, I felt the presence of the person I love behind me.
Ah...! As I thought... Sōta, you are...!
At that moment, the figures of Sōta and Omega perfectly overlapped.
"We meet again—Omega."
When I turned around, wearing a black robe and a black mask, he—Omega—was definitely standing there.
He silently stared at me.
Being looked at by him makes my entire body throb.
This feeling...! It's irresistible... ♡
"Always, always... you were watching over me right by my side..."
Thinking about it now, I feel like meeting him was completely inevitable.
"Also... there's something I have to apologize to you for no matter what. Um... I treated you like a pet so terribly..."
"...It's fine. Don't worry about it."
He said that as if he genuinely didn't mind.
Omega... you really are kind... But...
"But... I can't forgive myself. So I thought about it... how I could atone for this sin... I thought, and thought, and then I realized... I should just become your pet."
I took out the item I had prepared beforehand.
It was a collar.
I fastened it around my own neck.
"With this, I am your pet."
Fufu, with this, I am officially his property... Haa~ ♡ My heart feels fulfilled...
"My body and my heart all belong to you, so... please, do as you please?"
However, Omega just stood there, continuing to stare at me.
"Ah... I'm sorry. We need a chain in addition to the collar, don't we..."
"...No, it is unnecessary."
Saying only that, Omega approached me.
Then, he touched my collar.
Omega...
In the next instant, the collar shattered to pieces and eventually turned to dust and disappeared.
Ah... my proof of servitude to him...
"Furthermore, there is no need for you to become my pet."
"Eh? But..."
"It is unnecessary."
"I see..."
I wanted to become Omega's pet...
I felt a bit of lingering reluctance, but if he says it's unnecessary, it can't be helped.
"Then... at least let me be your kin. Is that okay...?"
"...Do as you please."
"Thank you, Omega."
I thanked him and kneeled before Omega.
"—I dedicate my body and soul entirely to you, and swear to live for your sake."
Yes, living for Omega's sake is the path I have chosen. I will eliminate any obstacle in Omega's way.
"...Mhm, I see... Then, farewell. Magical Girl Luna."
Immediately after, Omega suddenly vanished.
He left...
But I don't feel lonely. Because I know I will definitely be able to see him tomorrow, the day after, and every day from now on.
Fufu, even so, I can't help but think how happy my life is...
To be able to dedicate everything to the person I cherish. Where else in the world could I find greater happiness than this?
I want everyone else to understand someday too... about my Omega.
All five of us magical girls dedicating our bodies and souls to Omega. Not bad... no, it's a wonderful sight.
For that purpose as well, I must spread the word of Omega's greatness... as his missionary.
But... for now, just a little longer... I think I'll fully enjoy this time for just the two of us.
"Fufufufu, I love you... I love you, I love you, Lord Omega ♡"
In the darkness of the moonlit night, I quietly whispered my love for him.
"Ugh... my body... won't regenerate... properly...!"
Selec had somehow managed to survive Omega's blow in a near-death state and return to the Demon Realm, but his body was already past the point of saving.
He tried to regenerate, but his body kept melting into sludge. There was only one destination for Selec's fate... certain death.
If only... I had used those things, this wouldn't have...!
Selec regretted it from the bottom of his heart.
If he had used his trump cards, 'those things', he could have stood against even the overwhelmingly powerful Omega.
"To think... that I...! In a place like this...!"
Just as he finally lost the ability to regenerate and his body began to collapse, footsteps echoed from somewhere... *clack*, *clack*.
『What a pathetic display... And you call yourself one of the "Seven Demon Emperors"...?』
The figure that emerged from the darkness looked down at Selec, who was unable to stand.
"Ghk...! M-My Lord... I am deeply sorry! To be seen in such a state..."
『To think you would be beaten this badly... Was it a magical girl?』
"No... It was Omega..."
『Omega... again...』
In that instant, bloodlust radiated from Venuzfear.
The air grew so heavy that even breathing became an arduous task. However, even within that, Selec managed to squeeze out words.
"...I am deeply sorry... My Lord... I am already..."
『However—you are lucky. Selec... to have been able to make it back to me.』
The moment Venuzfear touched Selec, the collapse of his body stopped completely.
More than that, the sludgy body rapidly regenerated before his eyes.
"This is...!"
『You still have a role to play... It would be troublesome if you died.』
"You have my deepest gratitude, Lord Venuzfear...!"
『Show it through your actions, then. Be of use to me.』
"As you command."
Selec kneeled and bowed his head.
『Now then, Selec. Let me hear your report on this matter.』
"Yes, understood."
Selec recounted the entire battle.
Omega's intrusion... and... Magical Girl Luna's transformation.
"That concludes my report."
『Strange...』
Having finished listening to the report, Venuzfear muttered with a slightly displeased tone.
"Is something the matter, My Lord? Did something catch your attention?"
When Selec asked, Venuzfear looked off into the distance, as if in thought.
『Selec. This Magical Girl Luna you saw... she was transformed into a black form, correct?』
"Yes, that is correct. She looked almost like one of us demons."
『I see... A black form... That differs from the information I know. Is this also... Omega's influence...』
"Does that mean it differs from the <World's Scenario> you mentioned, My Lord?"

『Yes... Originally, Magical Girl Luna was supposed to die... But because he intervened in that fate, Magical Girl Luna is still alive. However—that is a trivial matter. It merely extended her life a little.』
Venuzfear said that and sneered.
For him, who had already slaughtered four magical girls of this world with his own hands, he could kill them anytime anyway, so it made no difference.
『From now on, the scenario I know will be useless in this world. It is about to walk toward a future different from its original history.』
"I see."
『Selec, begin the next preparations. Actively mobilize the "Seven Demon Emperors".』
"Yes, understood. I will ensure that my Lord witnesses the end where the magical girls fall into despair, are broken, and are completely annihilated...!"
『Ah... I am truly looking forward to that... I expect much from you, Selec.』
